nodes.label: Starcom stack
nodes.rationale: Universal CCSDS data-link stack incubating in the RC monorepo; RC is first consumer not owner.

nodes.label: starcom::ccsds core
nodes.rationale: Sans-I/O portable library. No radio, clock, or event loop inside the core.

nodes.label: Starcom port
nodes.rationale: First-party adapter (host bearer, radio, later PIO/FPGA). May do I/O; core does not.

nodes.label: PLTU
nodes.rationale: Proximity Link Transmission Unit: ASM + one Transfer Frame + CRC-32.

nodes.label: PLTU CRC-32
nodes.rationale: 211.2 Annex C. G(X)=X32+X23+X21+X11+X2+1 (0x00A00805), init all-zero, ASM not covered.

nodes.label: USLP Version-4
nodes.rationale: Sits in the same PLTU in lieu of V-3; never nested inside the V-3 data field.

nodes.label: decode_pltu()
nodes.rationale: Complete candidate at ASM. Locates CRC via 211.2 §3.6.4 V-3 Frame Length. USLP 1100 is tfvn_unknown until increment 3.

nodes.label: Result<T>
nodes.rationale: tl::expected<T, Error> by default. STARCOM_USE_STD_EXPECTED later.

nodes.label: T/A/R/I verification methods
nodes.rationale: ECSS-E-ST-10-02. T is default. Not all four on every increment.

nodes.label: D-5 heap trap
nodes.rationale: malloc/operator new trap is pass/fail on host tests of the core; positive control required.

nodes.label: D-4 PLTU wraps V-3 XOR USLP
nodes.norm_label: d-4 pltu wraps v-3 xor uslp

nodes.label: sans-I/O
nodes.rationale: Bytes and timeouts in, events and bytes out. Core never keys a transmitter.

nodes.label: PLTU repeater
nodes.rationale: Early RC capability after codecs. Regenerative forward of a PLTU. Grade bent vs buffered open.

nodes.label: PIO port seam
nodes.rationale: Later port: ASM hunt, symbol timing, Manchester/FSK-continuous on RP2350.

nodes.label: FPGA port seam
nodes.rationale: Later port: 211.1 / C&S (conv, PLTU on the wire). HDL sim before bitstream.

nodes.label: DUPLEX / section 6 MAC
nodes.rationale: full/half/simplex lives in 211.0 §6, not in PLTU codecs. Not decided.
